notes.title: STREET DREAMS - OUT NOW
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001601/501fb5acfdbf9b6112ddc56c39fcc19574eb15fe.gif

It's release day! 🎉🥳 
To celebrate, Street Dreams will have a 30% launch-week discount!

Get ahead of the competition - earn your place at the top of the leaderboards!

After months of development, I'm super excited to finally be releasing Street Dreams! If you have any feedback at all - bugs, gameplay improvements, what you love/hate - please let me know on Twitter @AnthonySturdy.

- Anthony
🚙     🚗🚗🚗
